'''April 2001 Georgia tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Book Exchange, GA in April 2001. [[Paul Myers]] won it. It is known from Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2264">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-08-ga-states-aka-atlanta-v-augusta-5-5-01d2264/ ga-states-aka-atlanta-v-augusta-5-5-01], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 8 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-08-ga-states-aka-atlanta-v-augusta-5-5-01d2264/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' April 2001
* '''Site:''' Book Exchange, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Myers]]
